challenge.better_approach: The dedent is the smallest change; a try/except around the AF_UNIX branch would hide the bug, not fix it.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That Windows has no AF_UNIX on the interpreter in use: measured, the traceback reaches line 250 with rec unbound, which only happens when hasattr(socket,'AF_UNIX') is false.
challenge.prior_art: Grepped CairnCommons tickets and questions for _dial / UnboundLocalError / bus.port: no ticket owns this path; 3dc005de27cf (db reaches postgres over tcp) is a different component. Checked congruency-lab for bus_client: its charter owns remote.py.
challenge.real_collision: None: f62f6b50b047's proof measures held_connection on Linux sockets; this restores the Windows path it moved. Not exclusive-and-terminal with it.

answers.falsifier: With socket.AF_UNIX deleted, _dial returns a connection to the loopback listener named in bus.port and the record's key; a missing or port-less record raises FileNotFoundError; the proof is red today and green after the dedent.
answers.from_idea: none, because this is a bug measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell: cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py:245-250 (grep of tickets and questions found no ticket for _dial's Windows path; f62f6b50b047 is the commit that introduced it)
answers.how: Dedent the no-AF_UNIX block in remote.py _dial so it runs after the AF_UNIX branch returns; red-first proof deletes socket.AF_UNIX in-process so Linux measures the Windows branch.
answers.traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default; a green earned) and Law 3 (measured 2026-11-20: every bus call on akiendell raises UnboundLocalError); outline 5.4.3 bus is the only device-to-device path.
answers.what: bus_client's _dial dials the loopback port recorded in bus.port where Python has no AF_UNIX, instead of dying with UnboundLocalError on rec.

bullets.text: f62f6b50b047 broke every bus call on Windows; Linux proofs could not see it. The fix proof deletes AF_UNIX in-process so it reads on every host.

title: bus_client's _dial dials the loopback port recorded in bus.port where Python has no AF_UNIX, instead of dying with Unbou
